item.description: Dual Enrollment Student Receives Prestigious Scholarship michelle.laggan Fri, 04/03/2026 - 16:19 Julian “Jules” Lees is a high school senior and a dual enrollment student at Community College of Philadelphia through a partnership with MaST Charter schools, allowing him to graduate from high school this May with 69 college credits and an associate degree in Health Care Studies. Next up for Jules is embarking on the next leg of his educational journey—an undergraduate degree at Swarthmore College.
